## What is actually constructed

1. **`S1896IdentityOpenImmersion`** — for every field `F` and etale stack `Y`, `Iut.EtaleStackOpenImmersion (id Y.fiber)`. This is the **first inhabitant in the tree** of `EtaleStackRepresentableMorphismProperty` (S1887's "no inhabitant exists" is superseded). Per test scheme `T` and scheme point `p`: `S1896IdentityBaseChange ... : EtaleStackBaseChangePresentation (id Y.fiber) T p` with `pullbackScheme = T`, `projection = 𝟙 T`, `toSource = p`, and a **full `TwoPullbackWitness`** — the actual 2-pullback of `(𝟙, p)` is the test scheme itself (S1804's "apex = the scheme" model), so no schematic fiber product beyond `T` is needed. Key bricks: unit comparison `S1896YonedaOneIso : S1742StrongTransOfHom (𝟙 T) ≅ 𝟙 h_T`, the right-whiskering unit law, the exchange law, and `S1896Modification_subsingleton` (2-cells into a represented stack have discrete components).

2. **Exact first missing, localised** — `S1896CuspEquivOpenData : OrbicurveBoundaryCusp X ≃ Σ D, S1896CuspPointData D` and `S1896FirstMissing_structure : Nonempty (S1887D9CuspFirstMissing l S) ↔ ∃ D : S1896CuspOpenData S.cK, Nonempty (S1896CuspPointData D)`.

3. **Anti-fake** — `S1896Id_not_boundary` (the identity open map can never satisfy the boundary condition, any candidate compactification `= X.stack`, any candidate point), `S1896Cusp_openMap_app_not_essSurj` (every cusp's open map is non-essentially-surjective at its boundary residue scheme), `S1896D9Cusp_identity_not_openImmersion`. So the identity open immersion is explicitly *not* offered as the cusp: the representability machinery is no longer the obstruction; the remaining input is the geometric compactification of `C_K`, downstream of `S1881D9OrbicurveMissing`. No compactification/cusp/non-identity open immersion is constructed, and no mathlib scheme pullback is used.

## Two Lean-level facts worth propagating

- Two *defeq but syntactically different* `Category` instances coexist on `StrongTrans X Y` (`EtaleStackPseudofunctor.homCategory` vs mathlib's scoped one), so `whisker_exchange`/`whiskerRight_id`/`whiskerRight_iff`/`whiskerLeftIso`/`rightUnitor` fail to elaborate directly at `EtaleStackPseudofunctor F`; the S1756 wrapper pattern (`@Bicategory.<lemma> Bicat _ ...`) is required — generalised in §0 and reusable.
- After `simp only [Category.assoc]` a mixed-instance 2-cell goal can remain; `rfl` closes it.

Report: [`coord/reports/S1896-boundary-cusp-actual.md`](coord/reports/S1896-boundary-cusp-actual.md); an entry was appended to [`AUDIT_LEDGER.md`](AUDIT_LEDGER.md). `coord/dag`/`STATE`/`queue` were left untouched (reported to the parent instead, to avoid concurrent-edit conflicts).
